title: Abridge reduces Clinicians paperwork
description: Abridge turns conversations with patients into draft medical notes for clinicians to review. This reduces the paperwork that spills into evenings. In a May 2026 account, Geisinger reported that more than 1,000 clinicians were using Abridge. Clinicians spent about 45 fewer minutes writing notes for every eight hours of scheduled patient care. In primary care, reported burnout and work outside normal hours each fell by about 50%. Abridge reports that its tools are used across more than 300 health systems.
